_about: Gems (Godot build: game/core/gems.gd). Shards from mining are combined at a jeweller (an npc with `jeweller: true`): `gemQualities` lowest first, the first made from `count` shards of a type, each later one from `count` gems of the quality below. Every type and quality pair is a gem item (id `<type>_<quality>`, made by the engine, so it is not listed in items.json). A gem in a socket gives `pointsPerLevel` x (its quality's `level` + 4) stat points, the same slice of the item budget a socket takes from its item (forge.json `sockets.share`), spent on its type's `stat` (or shared between its `stats`), so a gem of the item's own quality only fills the socket back; a better gem is an upgrade. `effect` gems give something other than stats: `gatherSkill` (Mining, Skinning and Fishing ranks) or `buffDuration` (percent longer Well Fed), by quality from `perQuality`. `slots`: the only slots it fits. Gems come out free at any jeweller and are never destroyed.
